The '''1949 Wayne State Wildcats football team''' represented Nebraska State Teachers College at Wayne (later renamed [[Wayne State College]]) as a member of the [[Nebraska College Conference]] (NCC) during the [[1949 college football season]]. In their first year under head coach  [[Jack Wink]], the Wildcats compiled a perfect 9–0 record (8–0 against NCC opponents), outscored opponents by a total of 218 to 67, and won the NCC championship.<ref>{{cite news |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.--> |title=Midland Ends NCC Season in Last Place Tie |url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/40727848/fremont_tribune/ |newspaper=[[Fremont Tribune]] |location=[[Fremont, Nebraska]] |date=November 14, 1949 |page=10 |access-date=December 17, 2019 |via=[[Newspapers.com]] {{Open access}} }}</ref>

Wink was hired as the team's head coach in late July 1949. He previously played  at quarterback for the [[1942 Wisconsin Badgers football team]] and the [[1943 Michigan Wolverines football team]], both of which were ranked No. 3 in the final [[AP Poll]]s.<ref>{{cite news|title=Wisconsin Grid Star New College Coach|newspaper=The Wayne Herald|date=July 28, 1949|page=3|url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/the-wayne-herald-jack-wink/139709418/|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}}</ref>

The team played its home games at the new Wayne Memorial Stadium in [[Wayne, Nebraska]]. The new concrete stadium was dedicated by Governor [[Val Peterson]] on September 9, 1949.<ref>{{cite news|title=Memorial Stadium Is Dedicated at Ceremony; Governor Gives Address|newspaper=The Goldenrod|date=September 16, 1949|page=1|url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/the-goldenrod-memorial-stadium-is-dedica/139707720/|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Advertisement part 1|newspaper=The Wayne Herald|date=September 8, 1949|page=13|url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/the-wayne-herald-ad/139706932/|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Advertisement part 2|newspaper=The Wayne Herald|date=September 8, 1949|page=13|url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/the-wayne-herald-ad/139706776/|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}}</ref>

The 1949 team was the first, and remains the only, Wayne State team to compile a [[perfect season]] in more than 100 years of the program's history. (The 1931 team was also undefeated but had a tie on its record.)<ref>{{cite web|title=Wayne St. (NE) Records by Year|publisher=College Football Data Warehouse|accessdate=January 27, 2024|url=http://www.cfbdatawarehouse.com/data/incomplete_data/year_by_year_current.php?teamid=3456|archive-date=September 6, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150906124707/http://www.cfbdatawarehouse.com/data/incomplete_data/year_by_year_current.php?teamid=3456|url-status=dead}}</ref>
